description: Single-panel scatter plot, lettered "(a)" in the top-left corner, with a logarithmic ordinate labelled "d_Car, nm" spanning 0.1 to 100 nm (labelled ticks 0.1, 1, 10, 100 with minor log ticks) and a linear abscissa labelled "Element content, mass%" from 0 to 40 (labelled ticks 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 with unlabelled minor ticks every 5). The legend defines three marker series: open stars = Al%, filled blue circles = Mn%, open red squares = 10×C%. Roughly five star points lie at low x (about 7-11 mass%) with d_Car rising from near the 0.5 nm level to a few nm. Roughly five open red squares span x ≈ 5-14 and d_Car from about 1 nm up to several tens of nm; because the series is labelled 10×C%, these abscissae correspond to actual C contents of roughly 0.5-1.4 mass%. Four blue circles fall from about 20 nm at ~15 mass% Mn to about 2 nm at ~35 mass% Mn. Three guide lines are drawn: a red solid line and a black dashed line both rise steeply through the Al and C data, while a blue dashed line falls gently through the Mn data. No numeric data labels are printed, so all values are read only against the gridlines. The panel demonstrates that κ-carbide size d_Car coarsens strongly with increasing C and Al content but is refined by increasing Mn content.

observations.observation: The figure is a single semi-log scatter plot with ordinate 'd_Car, nm' on a logarithmic scale from 0.1 to 100 and abscissa 'Element content, mass%' on a linear scale from 0 to 40.
The legend lists exactly three series: open star symbol = Al%, filled blue circle = Mn%, open red square = 10×C%.
The Al% (star) points are all located below about 12 mass% on the abscissa and increase in d_Car from near the 0.5 nm level to a few nm, indicating Al content increases carbide size.
The 10×C% (open red square) points span roughly 5 to 14 on the abscissa and rise from about 1 nm to several tens of nm, the steepest increase of any series.
The plotted abscissa for the square series is 10×C%, so the printed x-values correspond to actual carbon contents about ten times smaller (roughly 0.5-1.4 mass% C).
The Mn% (filled blue circle) series decreases monotonically from about 20 nm at ~15 mass% Mn to roughly 2 nm at ~35 mass% Mn, opposite in sign to the Al and C trends.
Three guide/trend lines are drawn: a red solid line and a black dashed line rise steeply, while a blue dashed line falls gently through the Mn points.
No numeric data labels or table values are printed anywhere on the panel; data values can only be read approximately against the log gridlines.
All three alloying elements (Al, Mn, C) are plotted against one shared abscissa in mass%, so the three series occupy different x-ranges rather than being separate panels.
The panel carries no sample or condition identifiers beyond the element-series legend entries.

subfigures.description: Semi-log scatter plot of carbide size d_Car (nm, log scale 0.1–100) against element content (mass%, 0–40) for three marker series: open stars = Al%, filled blue circles = Mn%, open red squares = 10×C%. Red solid and black dashed guide lines rise steeply through the low-x Al/C data; a blue dashed line descends through the Mn data. No numeric data labels are printed.
